summary: Frontend-only validation of CSV import UX fix (bug: 'Dry run imported' banner shown but no rows persisted). All 4 requested scenarios PASSED. window.confirm() completely removed; auto dry-run on file selection now shows a 'Preview (not saved yet)' banner with an explicit 'Confirm & Import' CTA that actually persists the data on click. Verified across Staff Bulk Import, Coupon Upload, Brand↔Category Mapping, and the Cancel path.

test_scenarios_executed.steps: Upload staff CSV (2 rows) -> preview banner shows 'Preview (not saved yet): 2 will be imported' with confirm-import-btn & cancel-import-btn visible; rows NOT in table before confirm; after clicking confirm-import-btn banner switches to 'Last import result: 2 imported' and both rows appear in the staff table.

SRC_RWA source, upload coupons CSV (3 rows) -> 'Preview (not saved yet): 3 will be imported' banner + confirm-coupon-btn/cancel-coupon-btn visible; codes NOT visible in All Coupons before confirm; after confirm banner switches to 'Last upload: 3 imported' and all 3 codes appear in All Coupons tab.
Upload staff CSV -> preview banner -> click cancel-import-btn -> import-result-banner disappears and cancelled row is NOT persisted (search returns 0 occurrences).

Slabs tab -> upload brand-category mapping CSV -> mapping-result-banner shows 'Preview (not saved yet): 0 will be updated · 1 new · 0 invalid' with confirm-mapping-btn and cancel-mapping-btn visible; no window.confirm dialog.

critical_code_review_comments: StaffIncentives.jsx is 968 lines — consider splitting into sub-components (StaffTab, SlabsTab, MappingSection) for maintainability.

Repeated 'Preview / Last import result / dry_run summary' banner pattern is duplicated across Staff, Coupon, and Mapping flows; can be extracted into a reusable <ImportPreviewBanner /> component to keep the three call sites DRY.
seed_data_creation: Test data persisted (will remain in preview DB): 2 staff rows (TEST_ImpChk_*_A/_B) under brand BrandChk_*; 3 coupons TESTCP<suffix>0..2 under source SRC_RWA / brand CBrand_*; 1 brand-category mapping BrandMap_* -> TestCategory_*. Cancel-flow rows were NOT saved (as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The CSV import UX fix (removal of window.confirm + explicit 'Confirm & Import' CTA) is fully validated for Staff, Coupon, and Brand-Category Mapping flows plus the Cancel path. Data-testids: confirm-import-btn / cancel-import-btn / import-result-banner (staff), confirm-coupon-btn / cancel-coupon-btn / coupon-upload-result-banner (coupon), confirm-mapping-btn / cancel-mapping-btn / mapping-result-banner (mapping).
